notes.title: Update V380: New Features, Achievements, and Balancing Improvements!
notes.content:
Update V 380

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531247/9a0e1ee94ddf5777fa0a9451504c89ede9755abb.gif[/img]

Hey everyone!

In this major update, I've added the option to select minis from the main menu (after completing the game once). I've also introduced Steam achievements and made some balance adjustments.

I’ve reworked a lot of the code, so please let me know if you come across any bugs.

If you're enjoying the game, please consider leaving a review—I'm doing my best to create the best possible experience for you all.

What's new in this update:

[list]
[*] Mini selection menu added
[*] Autoskip to the card game when maximum losses are reached
[*] Spiders now run away when touched with the mouse
[*] Steam achievements added
[*] Removed random flies
[*] Difficulty balanced further across all levels
[*] Shortened the doors mini-game
[*] Fixed all known bugs
[/list]

Thanks for your continued support!

notes.title: Major BALANCE changes to difficutly - Update V377
notes.content:
Hey everyone! In this new update, I've rebalanced the entire game. Every single mini-game has been reviewed, and it should feel less punishing now. In particular, the doors mini-game should be easier to understand and play.

Please share your feedback and let me know what you'd like to see updated next!

tags.balance_change: - Every single mini-game has been reviewed, and it should feel less punishing now.
- In particular, the doors mini-game should be easier to understand and play.

notes.title: Quick update balancing difficulty V 372
notes.content:
So I just released a quick update to balance the difficulty of the top-down mini-levels; it's much more forgiving now. I'm also working on a bigger update that brings more balance changes and improvements, which I plan to release tonight or tomorrow. Please let me know how it feels!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44531247/4191f1c70be6ade5bca864c032a88ad89ae4c04e.gif[/img]

[b]V372:[/b]

[list]
[*] Lasers appear less often.
[*] The opening door mini-game is more forgiving now.
[*] Rotating objects are slower.
[*] Rearranged levels a bit to make them easier.
[/list]

Looking forward to your feedback!

notes.title: JoY is Out Today! + Day 1 Patch Update
notes.content: Hey everyone! I’m excited to finally release JoY after months of hard work. Today, I've also released a Day 1 update that fixes all known bugs, including a major one where the game started without audio. I've also balanced the difficulty of some mini-levels. If you find any new bugs, please let me know so I can fix them right away. I’m also open to any feedback or suggestions!
